description: Contracts for DbRelay, a lightweight transactional outbox for .NET: IOutbox, OutboxMessage, IMessageDeliveryHandler and DeliveryResult. Reference this package from application and handler code; it has no dependencies.

PostgreSQL storage provider for DbRelay (Npgsql): transactional outbox inserts in the caller's NpgsqlTransaction, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claiming with leases and lock tokens, retention cleanup and explicit, idempotent schema creation.

DbRelay engine: transactional outbox registration, background dispatcher with leases and lock tokens, retries with jittered backoff, dead-lettering, health checks and OpenTelemetry-compatible traces and metrics. Pair it with a storage provider such as DbRelay.PostgreSql.
